Lina (Orthros): Hey CS, Orthros needs a domain-tuned summarizer for underwriting docs. Requirements: private deployment, HSM KMS, deterministic outputs for audits, low-ish latency (target 200-400ms), nightly batch. Renewal in 4 months so delivery impacts retention.
Maya (CS): Got it. Quick clarifying q: does 'deterministic' mean identical tokenization across runs or bit-for-bit identical responses?
Lina (Orthros): They need reproducible summaries for the same input+model version+seed used by auditors. So determinism at the output level is required for compliance.
Devin (SE): For reproducible outputs we should avoid aggressive quantization and sampling. Suggest fp16 or q8_0 with fixed decoding (no sampling) and a locked RNG seed. Private deployment on their VPC and dedicated Redwood Private pool.
Maya (CS): Action list: 1) customer provides representative doc samples & redaction policy, 2) define SLOs (latency/throughput), 3) safety/regression eval spec, 4) cost estimate variants (fp16 vs q8). Lina, can you gather samples?
Lina (Orthros): Will share scrubbed samples by Wed EOD. Redaction: mask SSNs, keep claim IDs and dates.
Sam (Support): Plan a staged rollout: infra mirror -> smoke canary -> 72-hour validation (human review). I'll arrange coverage and on-call runbook.
Devin (SE): I'll open INF ticket for HSM onboarding and private plane setup, and post perf bench for both model variants. Note: quantized models may be cheaper but less deterministic; include fallback routing to smaller model for latency spikes.
InfraBot: Created INF-2026-2527 assigned to Devin (SE) for private deploy + HSM.
Maya (CS): For safety evals propose: 400 prompt tests (PHI edge cases), automated leakage detectors, and 75 manual reviews. Acceptance: <1% PHI leakage; summary fidelity >0.85 on ROUGE-L against gold set.
Devin (SE): Please also provide an evaluation harness (CSV of queries + expected outputs) to automate regressions. Example: python snippet to run harness.
Lina (Orthros): I'll coordinate with customer's security team about KMS certs and key rotation policy (they require 90-day rotation).
Maya (CS): I'll draft onboarding playbook, renewal risk mitigation note, and an enablement one-pager for their product team. Follow-ups: Lina shares samples, Devin posts perf & INF updates, Sam schedules canary. I'll circle back in 48h.
Lina (Orthros): Thanks all — pinging here once samples are uploaded.
Maya (CS): Marking thread blocked until samples land. Moving to #renewal-watch for visibility. :eyes:
